{{Top|leg}}
The '''University of Byblos''' was a prestigious college based in one of the city towers of [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]]. It was one of the most respected institutions of learning in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and had a great variety of departments, including advanced hyperspace theories, alien languages, and intergalactic archaeology. During the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the number of students enrolled at the university was about two million. There were also approximately 100,000 professors on staff.

==Notable professors and graduates==
*[[Reina Solov]] - Professor of archaeology
*[[Allor Vybb]] - Professor of metallurgy and energy physics
*[[Renn Volz]] - Inventor of the ''[[Ionic Ring Ship]]''
*[[Lancer Brunou]] - Professor of archaeology
*[[Genna Seedar]] - Medical student
